C1063.title: Yiyang Mobile Assists Police in Swiftly Dismantling a VOIP Fraud Operation
C1063.summary: In December 2025, Yiyang Mobile assisted public security authorities in successfully dismantling two sites using VOIP devices for telecom network fraud, leading to the arrest of suspects and seizure of two VOIP device sets. The suspects had illegally connected VOIP devices to the network to provide communication support for overseas fraud operations.
